name: Lakeland Community College
oos_note: Public JUCO. Out-of-state/non-resident tuition & fees, annual full-time (30 credit hrs) basis, Spring 2026 rates from official Lakeland CC tuition page (lakelandcc.edu/web/about/tuition-controller): tuition $349.05/cr x 30 = $10,471.50; general fee $11.80/cr, career services fee $8.25/cr, student support fee $14.25/cr x 30 = ~$1,029; total ~$11,500. 2025-26 academic year.
